partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Anatomy-specific signed regulatory intervention
results.hypothesis: Signed target-to-driver propagation should become more predictive when the target is expressed in an anatomy with both low disease and moderate expression fanout.
results.body: R043 plus same target-expression anatomy disease degree <=50 and human Bgee gene-expression degree <=6000
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines signed molecular propagation, causal-driver evidence, and jointly specific tissue context; only the disease gain-versus-loss direction remains unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: The signed molecular and anatomy motifs are TRAPI-expressible; two anatomy degrees, signed properties, exact absence, provenance, NPMI, and target degree require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target:Gene)-[regulation:REGULATES]->(driver)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
      <-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]-(object)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND regulation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(regulation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'NCBITaxon:9606' IN coalesce(target.in_taxon, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND anatomy._miner_human_gene_expression_degree <= 6000
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 5
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
      AND (
        evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
        OR evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 4
      )
    )
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: R055 plus target and causal driver share process[<=100 genes]
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines signed propagation, compact pathway coherence, causal-driver evidence, and jointly specific tissue context, leaving disease activity direction unresolved.
